On conclusion of investigation into the case police submitted charge-sheet against the present accused-opposite party Nos. 1-9 for the offence punishable under sections 143/323/324/326/307/379 of the Penal Code. and submitted FRT in respect of the remaining accused recommending their discharge. Offence under sections 326 and 307 being triable by the District Magistrate or by an Additional District Magistrate, the record of the case came up for disposal before the learned Additional District Magistrate, Pirojpur who, however, by his order dated 28-4-2002 discharged accused-opposite party Nos. 1-9. 

 14. In the result, the Rule is made absolute. The impugned judgment and order dated 11-11-2002 passed by the learned Sessions Judge, Pirojpur in Criminal Revision No. 93 of 2002 affirming those dated 28-4-2002 passed by the Additional District Magistrate, Pirojpur in Mathbaria PS Case No. 2 dated 1-5-2001 corresponding to GR Case No. 194 of 2001 under sections 143/323/324/326/307/379 of the Penal Code discharging the accused-opposite parties are hereby quashed. The learned Additional District Magistrate is directed to proceed with the case from the stage before discharging of the accused-opposite parties.
